name: How long does appliance area preparation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does appliance area preparation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of appliance area preparation depends on the extent of modifications needed. Minor preparations, like clearing a space, might take a few hours. More significant changes, such as electrical upgrades or plumbing reroutes, could take one to several days. Frasheski Construction will provide a timeline based on the specific requirements of your project during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation time varies, from a few hours for minor tasks to several days for significant electrical or plumbing modifications.
